rationale: Generic fractional-DPI sizing work. Pulp-owned Windows plug-in host code sizes the editor swapchain from the physical client rect WM_SIZE reports instead of re-deriving it from logical x scale, which lost a pixel at 125% and 150% and stretched every frame over the window. SkiaSurface::read_current_rgba() reads back at its source surface's size so the capture matches. Pulp-owned tests cover the geometry, a real CAMetalLayer readback, and the Windows host. Pulp continues to own these targets under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits the render change when the targets adopt the Vellum package (change event 20261025-render-readback-surface-size). No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'reported physical size|SkiaSurface reads back a presentable frame'
